The ggplot theme mvgam draws with

Source: R/plot_helpers.R
mvgam_theme.Rd

Every figure the package draws uses this theme, including the figures it draws through bayesplot. It extends ggplot2::theme_classic(). Apply it to a plot of your own to give it the look of mvgam output.

mvgam's figures take their colours from the "red" scheme of bayesplot, which bayesplot::color_scheme_get("red") returns. The example colours its points with it.

Usage

mvgam_theme(base_size = 11, base_family = "")

Arguments

base_size

Base font size in points. Defaults to 11, matching ggplot2::theme_classic().

base_family

Base font family. Defaults to "", the ggplot2 default.

Value

A ggplot2::theme() object.

See also

bayesplot::color_scheme_get()

Author

Nicholas J Clark

Examples

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +
  geom_point(colour = bayesplot::color_scheme_get("red")$dark) +
  mvgam_theme()
